{'text': 'iPhone Duo 256GB 版本起售價為 1999 美元，2TB 版本更高達令人咋舌的 3199 美元——不過其「可更換」的內部顯示層或許能讓消費者覺得花這麼多錢買一部手機是值得的。', 'paragraph_context': 'The iPhone Duo starts at $1999 for the 256GB model and rises to an eye-watering $3199 for the 2TB version – but a “renewable” inner display layer may help buyers to justify spending so much money on a phone.'}

{'text': 'Apple 以一個出奇地實惠的方案，解決了迄今摺疊手機遇到的最大問題……', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple has addressed the biggest problem experienced with folding phones to date via a surprisingly affordable option …'}

{'text': 'Android 摺疊手機最大的問題之一，是屏幕摺痕在新機時已可看見，而且在反覆開合後往往會更加明顯。據報 Apple 為減少這個問題，在鉸鏈及屏幕設計上下了大量功夫，早期的上手測試亦確認新機時幾乎看不見摺痕。', 'paragraph_context': 'One of the biggest problems of Android folding phones has been a crease that is visible when new and that tends to become even more so after repeated folding and unfolding over time. Apple reportedly put a huge amount of work into a hinge and display design intended to minimize this effect, and early hands-on sessions confirm that the crease is barely visible when new.'}

{'text': '然而，儘管如此，內層隨時間出現一定程度的可見退化仍然在所難免。事實上，Apple 亦承認這一點，硬件主管 Kate Bergeron 表示，公司已努力令它「盡可能長時間地磨合」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Despite this, however, it’s still likely that some visible degradation of the inner layer will occur over time. Indeed, the company has acknowledged this, with hardware lead Kate Bergeron saying that the company has worked hard to help it “wear in as long of a manner as we can.”'}

{'text': '以一部如此昂貴的裝置而言，這是一個潛在問題，因為大部分買家都會希望使用的時間遠比一般 iPhone 更長。不過 Bergeron 亦透露，當摺痕最終變得更明顯時，這層內部保護層是可以更換的。', 'paragraph_context': 'That’s a potential problem with a device so expensive it’s likely that most buyers will want to hold on to it for far longer than a typical iPhone, but Bergeron also revealed that this inner cover layer is replaceable once the crease does finally become more visible.'}

{'text': '「它其實是可以更換的，這對消費者來說是非常好的設計，你可以撕掉那層貼膜再換上一張新的。」', 'paragraph_context': 'It’s actually replaceable, which is a really nice thing for the customer, that you can peel off that layer and get a new one.'}

{'text': '我們當時已得悉，透過 AppleCare 更換的費用僅需 19 美元，現在知道沒有 AppleCare 的話則是 49 美元。對一部售價 2000 美元起跳的機器而言，這是讓內部顯示屏煥然一新的出奇地划算方法。正在考慮以長年使用來說服自己接受這個價格的消費者，很可能會認為這一點正是決定性的理由。', 'paragraph_context': 'We learned at the time that a replacement costs just $19 with AppleCare, and we now know that the price without is $49. For a machine costing $2k and up, that’s a surprisingly affordable way to make the inner display look like new again. Anyone thinking they might justify the price by holding on to the phone for a number of years may very well find this the deciding argument.'}

{'text': '你怎麼看？這個可更換的特性是否令機價變得較易接受？歡迎在留言區分享你的意見。', 'paragraph_context': 'What’s your view? Does this renewability make the price of the device more palatable? Please share your thoughts in the comments.'}
